# About

This document contains all runs in the Results folder of the repository.

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
source("aana_utils.R")
library(gtools)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
repo_path <- "../"
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
bayes_dir <- paste(repo_path, '20250405-221732/', sep='')
iterations_dirs <- dir(bayes_dir)
iterations_dirs <- iterations_dirs[which(substr(iterations_dirs, 1, 10)=='iteration_')]
iterations_dirs <- iterations_dirs[-which(iterations_dirs=='iteration_averages.csv')]

cat(file=stderr(), sprintf("\nFound %d iterations\n", length(iterations_dirs)))
```

```{r, results="asis", fig.align='center', out.width="100%"}

for (iter_dir in iterations_dirs[length(iterations_dirs)]) {
  
  results_in_dir <- mixedsort(dir(paste(bayes_dir, iter_dir, sep='')))
  
  cat(sprintf("\n\\clearpage\n\n# %s (%d results)\n", iter_dir, length(results_in_dir)))
  
  for (result in results_in_dir) {
  
    cat(sprintf("\n\\clearpage\n\n## %s - %s\n", iter_dir, result))
    
    result_data <- try(
      read_results_at_path(paste(paste(bayes_dir, iter_dir, "/", result,sep='')))
    )
    if (inherits(result_data, "try-error")) {
      next;
    } else {
      plot_run_results(result_data)
    }
  
  }
}
```
